hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ : كَانَ مَالِكٌ يَقُولُ فِي النُّفَسَاءِ : أَقْصَى مَا يُمْسِكُهَا الدَّمُ سِتُّونَ يَوْمًا ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ عن ذَلِكَ آخِرَ مَا لَقِينَاهُ , فَقَالَ : أَرَى أَنْ يُسْأَلَ عن ذَلِكَ النِّسَاءُ ، وَأَهْلُ الْمَعْرِفَةِ ، فَتَجْلِسُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ...
hadiths.english_translation: Ibn al-Qasim said: Malik used to say regarding the woman in post-natal bleeding: The maximum time that blood withholds her is sixty days, then he retracted from that at the end of what we met him, and said: I see that women and people of knowledge should be asked about that, then she sits (refrains from prayer) after that. Ibn Nafi' said, from 'Asim, from Abu Bakr ibn Umar, from Salim ibn Abdullah, that he was asked about the woman in post-natal bleeding: How long is the maximum she leaves prayer if the blood does not cease from her? He said: She leaves prayer for two months, that is the maximum she leaves prayer, then she performs ghusl and prays...

hadiths.arabicText: مَا جَاءَ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَامِلِ تَلِدُ وَلَدًا ، وَيَبْقَى فِي بَطْنِهَا آخَرُ
hadiths.english_translation: This is a chapter heading: What has come regarding the pregnant woman who gives birth to a child while another remains in her belly.

potential_issues.issue: This is a chapter heading, not a hadith with a chain of narration

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَامِلِ : تَلِدُ وَلَدًا ، وَيَبْقَى فِي بَطْنِهَا آخَرُ فَلَا تَضَعُهُ إِلَّا بَعْدَ شَهْرَيْنِ ، وَالدَّمُ يَتَمَادَى بِهَا فِيمَا بَيْنَ الْوَلَدَيْنِ...
hadiths.english_translation: Ibn al-Qasim said regarding the pregnant woman: She gives birth to a child, and another remains in her belly, so she does not deliver it except after two months, and the blood continues with her between the two children. He said: It is waited for the maximum of what the post-natal bleeding is with the woman in post-natal bleeding, and her husband has the right of return to her. And it has been said regarding her: That her condition is the condition of the pregnant woman until she delivers the second child...

hadiths.arabicText: فِي الْحَامِلَ تَرَى الدَّمَ عَلَى حَمْلِهَا
hadiths.english_translation: This is a chapter heading: Regarding the pregnant woman who sees blood during her pregnancy.

potential_issues.issue: This is a chapter heading, not a hadith with a chain of narration
potential_issues.impact: No chain analysis applicable

hadiths.arabicText: قُلْتُ : أَرَأَيْتَ الْحَامِلَ تَرَى الدَّمَ فِي حَمْلِهَا كَمْ تُمْسِكُ عن الصَّلَاةِ ؟ قَالَ : قَالَ مَالِكٌ : لَيْسَ أَوَّلُ الْحَمْلِ كَآخِرِهِ...
hadiths.english_translation: I said: What is your opinion about the pregnant woman who sees blood during her pregnancy, how long does she refrain from prayer? He said: Malik said: The beginning of pregnancy is not like its end. If she sees blood at the beginning of pregnancy, she refrains from prayer and what is exercised ijtihad for her in it, and there is no fixed limit in that. Ibn al-Qasim said: If she sees that in three months or so, she leaves prayer for fifteen days or so. If she exceeds six months of her pregnancy, then she sees it, she leaves prayer between that and twenty days or so.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ سَحْنُونٌ ، قَالَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ ، قَالَ مَالِكٌ : أَحَبُّ مَا جَاءَ فِي وَقْتِ صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ إِلَيَّ قَوْلُ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ : أَنْ صَلُّوا الظُّهْرَ وَالْفَيْءُ ذِرَاعٌ...
hadiths.english_translation: Sahnun said, Ibn al-Qasim said, Malik said: The most beloved of what has come to me regarding the time of Zuhr prayer is the statement of Umar ibn al-Khattab: That you should pray Zuhr when the shadow is a cubit. Ibn al-Qasim said, Malik said: And most beloved to me is that people pray Zuhr in winter and summer when the shadow is a cubit... And Ibn Umar used to sometimes ride during travel after the shadow becomes a cubit, and travel two or three miles before praying Zuhr. Ibn al-Qasim said: I did not see Malik define the time of Asr as two qamah heights, but rather in what I saw him describe, he used to say: And the sun is white and clear.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ سَحْنُونٌ ، عن ابْنِ الْقَاسِمِ ، عن مَالِكٍ ، عن نَافِعٍ ، عن ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ كَتَبَ إِلَى عُمَّالِهِ : إِنَّ أَهَمَّ أُمُورِكُمْ عندِي الصَّلَاةُ ، فَمَنْ حَفِظَهَا وَحَافَظَ عَلَيْهَا حَفِظَ دِينَهُ ، وَمَنْ ضَيَّعَهَا فَهُوَ لِمَا سِوَاهَا أَضِيَعُ , ثُمَّ كَتَبَ : أَنْ صَلُّوا الظُّهْرَ إِذَا كَانَ الْفَيْءُ ذِرَاعًا إِلَى أَنْ يَكُونَ ظِلُّ أَحَدِكُمْ مِثْلَهُ ، وَالْعَصْرَ وَالشَّمْسُ مُرْتَفِعَةٌ بَيْضَاءُ نَقِيَّةٌ قَدْرَ مَا يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فَرْسَخَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثَةً
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Ibn Umar: That Umar ibn al-Khattab wrote to his governors: The most important of your affairs to me is prayer, so whoever preserves it and maintains it preserves his religion, and whoever wastes it is more wasting of what is other than it. Then he wrote: That you should pray Zuhr when the shadow is a cubit until the shadow of one of you becomes like his height, and Asr while the sun is elevated, white and clear, about the distance a rider travels two or three farsakh.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ قَالَ مَالِكٌ : الْأَذَانُ : اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ، أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ...
hadiths.english_translation: Ibn al-Qasim said, Malik said: The Adhan is: Allah is Greater, Allah is Greater, I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah (twice), I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah (twice). He said: Then he repeats with a voice higher than his first voice, saying: I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah (twice), I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah (twice). He said: This is Malik's statement regarding raising the voice. Then: Come to prayer (twice), Come to success (twice), Allah is Greater, Allah is Greater, There is no deity except Allah. He said: If the Adhan is for Fajr prayer in travel or residence, he says: Prayer is better than sleep (twice) after 'Come to success'.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ : وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ ، عن عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ ، عن ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي غَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ مِنْ آلِ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ ، أَنَّ أَبَا مَحْذُورَةَ ، قَالَ : قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : اذْهَبْ فَأَذِّنْ عندَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ , قَالَ : قُلْتُ : كَيْفَ أُؤَذِّنُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ؟ قَالَ : فَعَلَّمَنِي الْأُولَى : اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ، أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ , ثُمَّ قَالَ : ارْجِعْ وَامْدُدْ مِنْ صَوْتِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ، أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ ، حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ ، حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ ، حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ ، الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ ، الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ فِي الْأُولَى مِنَ الصُّبْحِ ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Mahdhura: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: Go and call the Adhan at the Sacred Mosque. He said: I said: How do I call the Adhan, O Messenger of Allah? He said: So he taught me the first: Allah is Greater, Allah is Greater, I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah (twice), I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah (twice). Then he said: Return and extend from your voice: I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah (twice), I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah (twice), Come to prayer (twice), Come to success (twice), Prayer is better than sleep, Prayer is better than sleep in the first of Fajr, Allah is Greater, Allah is Greater, There is no deity except Allah.
